connector.name: Midas
connector.registryDescription: Local-first, source-traceable agent memory - no LLM at ingest, fully offline
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package midas-memory-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the vornicx account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: MIDAS_MCP_DB
env.description: Path to a SQLite file to persist memory across restarts (default: in-memory)

env.name: MIDAS_MCP_EMBEDDER
env.description: Embedding backend: 'local' (bge ONNX, offline) or 'hashing' (default: local)

env.name: MIDAS_MCP_MAX_RECORDS
env.description: Cap the store; above it the lowest-value memories are auto-forgotten (no LLM)

env.name: MIDAS_MCP_MIN_IMPORTANCE
env.description: Relevance floor 1-5 for auto-capture; turns scoring below it are skipped
